note: Laws in force on 1 January 2000; choices are gameplay judgements. Conscription: compulsory service for Jewish and Druze citizens, men and women, with exemptions (Haredi conscription remained a recurring coalition issue, per the 2026 election article). Press: a free press, subject to military censorship on security matters. Civil rights: a long-standing state of emergency allows emergency regulations, including administrative detention. Religion: no official state religion, but marriage and divorce fall under the religious courts of each recognised community. Immigration: the Law of Return grants citizenship to Jews; other immigration is restricted. Healthcare: universal coverage through competing health funds. Energy: no nuclear power stations. These descriptions have not been checked against a fetched source line by line.
